name: Sanna Virtanen
bio:
Sanna's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly during a university internship at a composite materials research lab. Intrigued by the application of advanced materials in high-performance environments, she quickly focused her studies on composite engineering. Her knack for understanding material behavior and her meticulous approach to fabrication led her to a role at a small racing team specializing in Formula Ford. There, she honed her skills in composite repair, design optimization, and structural analysis.

She is known for her calm demeanor under pressure and her ability to troubleshoot complex composite issues quickly and effectively. Sanna's drive for continuous improvement makes her a valuable asset, constantly seeking innovative solutions to enhance vehicle performance. She joined Andretti Global three years ago and has become a key member of their engineering team, focusing on aerodynamic components and chassis integrity. What sets her apart is her understanding of how materials behave at the limit and how to extract maximum performance while maintaining safety.

physical.hairStyle: Straight, shoulder-length hair, often pulled back in a low ponytail during work.
physical.description: Sanna is of average height with a lean build, a testament to her active lifestyle.

quirks: Always has a small notebook filled with material property data and sketches.
Meticulously cleans her workspace at the end of each day, regardless of how busy she is.
Secretly listens to death metal while working with carbon fiber.
